def: PyTorch's open-source runtime for deploying PyTorch models on mobile, embedded and desktop devices without converting them to another format, with backends for CPUs, GPUs and NPUs.
practice: Reached 1.0 in October 2025 with production-ready backends including XNNPACK, Core ML, Qualcomm AI Engine, Arm Ethos-U and Vulkan; Meta uses it in its apps and wearables.
